title: Ice Age Floods National Geologic Trail
summary: At the end of the last Ice Age, 18,000 to 15,000 years ago, an ice dam in northern Idaho created Glacial Lake Missoula stretching 3,000 square miles around Missoula, Montana. The Ice Age Floods forever changed the lives and landscape of the Pacific Northwest.
